description: Expo React Native app with the rich client-side native stack — Skia canvas, Reanimated v3 worklets, Gesture Handler, React Navigation stack + tabs.

defaults.headline: Starter Foundry Rich Mobile
defaults.subheadline: An Expo shell with Skia, Reanimated, Gesture Handler, and navigation — ready for GPU-rich UI.

buildHints.whenToUse: Pick expo-rn-rich when the app needs GPU-backed 2D drawing (Skia), worklet-driven 60fps animations (Reanimated v3), native gesture composition (Gesture Handler), and stack+tab navigation (React Navigation). If the user just needs a plain React Native shell without the animation stack, use expo-react-native-ts — this family pulls in ~15MB of extra native deps that need a dev client build.
architectureNotes: Reanimated v3 requires its Babel plugin to be the LAST plugin in babel.config.js — misordering silently breaks worklets with a 'Reanimated 2 failed to create a worklet' runtime error.
Gesture Handler's GestureHandlerRootView MUST wrap the entire app tree (in App.tsx), not just individual screens, or nested gestures drop events on Android.

@shopify/react-native-skia ships its own native module — it WILL NOT run inside Expo Go. The project requires a dev client (`eas build --profile development`) or `expo prebuild` to generate ios/android folders.
React Navigation uses screens from react-native-screens under the hood — enable via `enableScreens()` before the navigator renders for 30–40% lower memory on large stacks.
Screens go under src/screens/, navigators under src/navigation/. Keeping them split lets agents add new screens without rewriting the root.
components: RootNavigator — a Native Stack with a Bottom Tabs nested inside.
HomeScreen — plain RN list to contrast with the canvas screen.
CanvasScreen — a Skia <Canvas> driving an animated shader/shape via useSharedValue + useDerivedValue.
GestureHandlerRootView wrapper at the app root.
SafeAreaProvider wrapping the navigator for notched devices.
gotchas: Expo Go INCOMPATIBILITY: Skia + Reanimated v3 require a custom dev client. Document in README — users who run `npx expo start` and scan the QR with Expo Go will see 'Native module RNReanimated is not installed'.
Reanimated babel plugin order: `react-native-reanimated/plugin` MUST be the LAST entry in plugins array. This is the #1 Reanimated crash and the error message does not surface the cause.
iOS: Add 'NSCameraUsageDescription' / 'NSMicrophoneUsageDescription' to app.json → ios.infoPlist if any Skia shader loads a camera feed — iOS will silently crash the app on access without it.
Android: The `android.useLegacyPackaging` flag in app.json is needed for hermes-compatible Reanimated — without it the APK balloons by ~20MB.

`react-native-gesture-handler` must be imported at the TOP of the entry file (index.ts/App.tsx) — any imports BEFORE it will initialize without gesture handler patched in and fire warnings in production.
React Navigation v7 requires `@react-navigation/native`, `@react-navigation/native-stack`, and `@react-navigation/bottom-tabs` as separate installs. Missing one silently breaks the tab bar.

Worklet constraints: code inside `useAnimatedStyle` / `useAnimatedReaction` runs on the UI thread and cannot close over JS-thread variables unless marked with `'worklet'`. Mis-use shows up as 'ReferenceError: X is not defined' on interaction.
EAS Build: Reanimated + Skia push the build past Expo's free-tier 45-minute build limit on first run — set `cache.key` in eas.json to cache the native pods, or upgrade to a paid tier.
